english: Greetings, friend. How are ya?
How is the data retrieval progressing?
These cards seem a bit damp... but I can work with this! Thank you, <name>!
Why did the Light guide you here today?

Ah. Candles from Ironforge. 

While I am mostly able to live independently in my hermitage, there are a few key things that I appreciate from the city and the pious.
Farsight can show ye a great many things, even things ye'd rather not see.

So ye see now, <class>? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.

Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. Hows about a bit o' violence?
Light guide you on your tasks.

Ah, perfect. These will do--any that are too wet to use right now I will leave to dry.

Now, if you're willing, I have more tasks I could use help with.
Wendigos are nasty beasties. Its just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!
Now that's more like it! With these shipments we'll get the forge back up and runnin' in no time!
It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.

Yer a real lifesaver, <name>!

My husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bare tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.
You look chilly, <class>. How goes the hunt?
These pelts will make excellent saddles. You've done the Alliance proud, <class>!

These Dark Irons may be our cousins but they ain't family, that's for sure. I shed no tears for any misfortune that befalls them that stray too far from that accursed mountain o' theirs.

Hopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.
I wish we could have simply placated them. Unfortunately it was beyond my knowledge and they were too dangerous to leave unchecked.
'Ware the winter, friend.
Light bless you, <class>. Your efforts make this area much safer and hopefully will prevent unnecessary deaths.

Ach, the fool...

Thank ye for the help, <name>. Guess we have our report.

Ol' Whitebeard sent ya, aye?

I got his report, alright. This whole situation's a mess!

Ah, you're back just in time.

What's the matter, lad? You look like you've seen a ghost.

Completely overrun? Why am I not surprised.

Well, that's going in the report too.

<Senir folds Gretchen's letter into his pile of notes>
What's that you've got?

<The <race> turns pale as he sees the empty keg.>

...Where did you find this?
I hope you've got good news for me?

That should be all the stolen powder. Thank you, <class>.

Please accept this reward, and... I'd appreciate if you didn't mention this little incident to anyone.
What have you brought from the depths, <class>.

Ah yes, my ancestor Madoran was the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge following the great civil war between the Wildhammer, Bronzebeard, and Dark Iron clans. This treaty was drafted to codify the cessation of hostilities and terms of peace after the Bronzebeards won the mountain.

As you can see, the Wildhammers and Bronzebeards signed it... and the Dark Irons did not.

Thank you for recovering this and bringing it to me, <class>.
What do you need?
The mountaineers engrave their names on the stock of their rifles. It helps identify them should something happen. I'll send these back to Ironforge--there someone will pass them on to any family.
Oh what's this, then?

Judging by this map, it certainly looks like these Dark Irons are planning some sort of incursion into the vaults beneath Ironforge. The band ye busted up to the east must be a scouting force.

Thank ye for bringing me this. If we hurry, we might be able to beat them to whatever their goal is down there.
That banner looks like it's been in a war!

You found Ylva's body? Ah, the poor woman. She said she was going to show the troggs that Ironforge would never fall to their kind. She went looking for a few mountaineers who never returned from a patrol through trogg country. She was always too independent-minded to be cautious. Now we know what happened.

I'll take the banner back and make sure it's cleaned up and displayed. You should take her weapon. May it serve you well against the troggs.
I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick?

My hair clip! I thought this was lost for good!

This'll shine right up with just a little work. Thank you for bringing it to me! I'll make it worth your while.
Eh? What do you want?

This jar is for me?

Snow! Grenhild did it! She sent the snow that I asked for!

A pity, though, I was hoping she would come and visit in person.

Well, regardless, thank you for your effort. This is a real help for my work.
You're here to help with my delivery?  Very good!
